purpose: Generate a broad production-like discovery corpus from distinct requests against the frozen synthetic enterprise world.
rules: Collect actual Hermes and Relay trajectories from the unchanged baseline in OpenShell.
Each matrix row is a distinct user request; do not inflate corpus size by repeating prompts.
Use the same fixture, model route, and baseline harness throughout collection.
This matrix is a workload sampler, not an evaluation suite. Eval Author selects tasks from observed trace evidence.
